exposure: ACOG-SMFM 'Safe Prevention of the Primary Cesarean Delivery' publication
clear medical indication for cesarean section
cohort: 72 women with pathology-confirmed placenta accreta spectrum
finding: Many patients with placenta accreta spectrum had a potentially preventable primary Cesarean section, most commonly performed without clear medical indication or for malpresentation without attempted external cephalic version.
mod_finding: The study found that many patients with placenta accreta spectrum had undergone a potentially preventable primary cesarean section.
